messages.content: Write a short announcement for a new feature in a note-taking app: offline sync. Around 200 words.

**Offline Sync Is Here**

Your notes work the same whether you're on a plane, in a basement, or anywhere else the signal drops. Write, edit, and organize notes with no connection, and everything syncs the moment you're back online.

The app keeps a local copy of your notes on your device. When you make a change offline, it saves instantly and queues for sync. Reconnect, and the app merges your changes with the cloud automatically — no manual refresh, no lost work.

If you edit the same note on two devices while both are offline, we don't just pick one and discard the other. The app shows you both versions side by side so you can merge them yourself or choose the one you want to keep.

A few details: offline changes sync within seconds of reconnecting, depending on note size and connection speed. Attachments like images and files download for offline access only after you open them at least once while connected. Sync status shows in the top bar, where a small icon tells you when a note is fully synced, pending, or in conflict.

This has been our most requested feature for two years. Update the app today — your notes will keep up with you, connection or not.
